loss.metric: C=.5*R+.5*I; R=population standardized fit target covariance
loss.output_coordinates: original standardized two targets, no inverse rotation

selector_metric: original joint standardized MAE, raw state
training: original V12 random joint periodicTabM, constant AdamW; no SWA, EMA or Huber
control: original MetricRegressor BASE native joint MSE; true source identities retained; 0 new control fits

selection.development: each target independently: both full seed A20 gains positive AND mean increment versus raw BASE A20 positive; choose highest mean qualifying target only
selection.confirmation: retain chosen development target; four seed gains each positive, one-sided seed tLCB95(df3)>0 AND mean mechanism positive
selection.exploration: at most one positive-mean target, distinct from formal promotion; never automatic release

seed_history: previously used splits over same official rows; not new independent datasets
queue: first approved priority; internal member bootstrap remains fallback, no automatic new batch
